property_summary: In the reference, renounceRole(role, account) only ever succeeds when account == msg.sender, so a third party's call to renounce another account's role must revert and leave that account's role intact; the mutant lets any caller revoke any account's role, so hasRole(role, victim) becomes false for some input.
change_summary: Remove the self-check require so any caller can renounce (revoke) any account's role.
